narrative.overview: Slides Thief balances professional utility with minimalist elegance. Designed for high-density document editing and perspective correction, the interface uses a structured 3-column workspace.
keyCharacteristics: Slate Ink & Teal Precision Tonal Palette

rules.name: The Single Accent Rule
rules.body: Terracotta accent is used exclusively for key identity and critical attention states. Functional quad overlays use Teal Precision.

dos: Do use CSS custom variables (var(--...)) for all surface and text colors.
Do include keyboard accessibility and ARIA descriptions for canvas handles.
donts: Don't add fixed pixel height constraints to slide list containers.
Don't use generic vibrant SaaS gradients (purple/cyan) on card backgrounds.
Don't execute image processing on the main UI thread.
